Fit statistics

fitstats.Rd

Fit statistics of one model, as Mplus prints them under MODEL FIT INFORMATION.

Usage

fitstats(object)

Arguments

object

A fitted latentmix model.

Value

A one-row data frame with the available columns among K (classes), T (waves, LTA), groups (multigroup), n, npar, ll, aic, bic, sabic, caic, entropy, smallest (smallest class proportion; not for LTA and multigroup models), replicated and starts.

Details

AIC \(= -2LL + 2p\), BIC \(= -2LL + p\log n\), sample-size adjusted BIC uses \(n^* = (n + 2)/24\) in place of \(n\), and CAIC \(= -2LL + p(\log n + 1)\), with \(p\) free parameters and \(n\) analysed rows. Entropy is the relative entropy (Mplus "Entropy"; for an LTA, over the joint class paths). replicated counts how many of the starts final-stage starts reached the best log-likelihood.

See also

fittable(), lm_table(), lmr(), blrt()

Examples

data(aces)
# \donttest{
# fit statistics of the 4-class ACE model
fitstats(lca(aces, starts_with("ace_"), K = 4))   # LL, npar, AIC, BIC, entropy, ...
#> Starting Julia ...
#>   K    n npar        ll      aic      bic    sabic     caic   entropy
#> 1 4 1500   35 -5248.007 10566.01 10751.98 10640.79 10786.98 0.7593466
#>     smallest replicated starts
#> 1 0.09873811         20     20
# }
